title: Star Take dev
author: hezakidenzel
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’m currently developing a browser-based space strategy/planet management game and I’m looking for people willing to help test it and share feedback.

The game is still in a very early development phase, so expect bugs, balance issues, unfinished systems, and possible account resets/wipes during updates. The purpose right now is mainly to test mechanics, progression, economy, and to see if the overall gameplay is actually fun and interesting.

If you enjoy games focused on:

Planet management

Resource extraction

Economy and trading

Fleets and space battles

Turn-based strategy

Survival and progression

…then I’d really appreciate your feedback.

The goal is to build the kind of space strategy game I always wanted to play with friends, and community feedback at this stage helps a lot.

If you want to test it, send me a message or join the server. Any opinion, criticism, or suggestion is welcome.

https://startake.com.br/
